item.title: Battlefield 6 streamlines some of the most annoying Challenges yet again, takes out a few of them entirely
item.description: The easier and more accessible Battlefield Studios makes those Battlefield 6 Challenges, the better.

item.title: Arc Raiders patch nerfs the Deadline mine, ends the menace of the Venator
item.description: The first post-Stella Montis patch for Arc Raiders has arrived, and it predictably touches much of what people brought to the latest map.

item.title: Battlefield 6 may have actually done it: beaten Call of Duty
item.description: Battlefield 6 sales are setting all kinds of records, but one in particular has long eluded the Battlefield series.

item.title: PUBG's extraction shooter spin-off, Black Budget, is finally going to be playable next month
item.description: The most interesting development in the PUBG universe, PUBG: Black Budget, is almost ready to show itself off to a wider group of players.

item.title: Dragon boy Durin is the star of the show in Genshin Impact's wintry Luna 3 update, launching in early December
item.description: Genshin Impact is getting two new characters and a whole host of new content in Version Luna 3, which arrives in under two weeks.

item.title: Battlefield 6 kicks off its first free trial post the Black Ops 7 launch to twist that knife
item.description: Activision has done its own fair share of Battlefield 6 counterprogramming prior to that game's release, and EA is here to repay the favour with Black Ops 7.

item.title: Infinity Nikki 2.0 launches with a whole new region, archery skills, and a new theme song by original Wicked actor Idina Menzel
item.description: Infinity Nikki's version 2.0 is the game's biggest evolution yet, transforming almost every part of it.

item.title: The latest Arc Raiders patch is almost entirely about fixing exploits, including all the clipping through locked rooms business
item.description: Embark is clearly sick of Arc Raiders players exploiting the game's mechanics to push each other around, and clip through doors and walls.

item.title: They know what you want, and it's bloody disgusting: Love and Deepspace's latest Myth introduces Vampire Sylus
item.description: One year after Sylus got his second Myth, the third one arrives to make good on all those vampire fantasies.

item.title: Battlefield Labs is coming back for a short session to test out next week's Battlefield 6 update, and you can expect more tests in the future, too
item.description: Battlefield Labs is evolving, as it reopens its doors for its next - unusual - session.
